stories.h: O'Donnell claims win in tight state Supreme Court race
stories.s: King County Judge Sean O'Donnell, backed by the GOP, declared victory over appeals Judge Ian Birk. He leads by about 39,000 votes with fewer than 100,000 ballots left statewide, after heavy late outside spending.

stories.h: Parents, teachers union sue to block trans athlete initiative
stories.s: A week after voters approved I-638, TransFamilies, the Washington Education Association and parents sued in King County Superior Court. They say the measure violates the state constitution's privacy and anti-discrimination protections.

stories.h: State Supreme Court weighs rules that could cut cash bail
stories.s: Justices heard nearly three hours of arguments on proposed court rules limiting bail. Public defenders support them; prosecutors, judges and bail agents oppose. No decision was made, and a committee will review hundreds of comments.

stories.h: Record warmth today, then rain returns Thursday night
stories.s: Western Washington gets a mild, mostly dry break before widespread rain arrives Thursday night. Friday looks wet and breezy, with more rain and wind Sunday. Highs drop back into the 50s.

stories.h: Ocean Shores declares emergency as storms erode coastline
stories.s: Erosion, coastal flooding and long power outages led the Grays Harbor city to declare a citywide emergency. Officials told people to stay off beaches. Seattle Public Utilities asks residents to clear leaf-clogged storm drains.

stories.h: Groups seek three-year moratorium on new data centers
stories.s: Several Washington organizations want lawmakers to pass a statewide pause on new data centers in 2027. They cite water scarcity, noise and grid strain. Gov. Ferguson has said he expects the Legislature to act on data centers.

talking.h: Kraken take NHL Global Series to Helsinki
talking.s: Seattle faces Carolina twice this week at Veikkaus Arena in Finland, and has been practicing in a rink about 121 feet underground that also serves as a civil defense shelter.

talking.h: Viral Ballard raccoon Jimothy draws death threats
talking.s: The fan page for Jimothy, a raccoon with an apparent short-spine condition, says he has been threatened online. It is asking people to stop sharing where he can be found.

talking.h: Seahawks stand pat at trade deadline
talking.s: GM John Schneider made no deadline deals and kept his 2027 picks. That leaves current players, including Rashid Shaheed and Dante Fowler Jr., needing to produce as Seattle chases a second straight Super Bowl.

coming.h: Kraken open Helsinki series vs. Hurricanes
coming.s: The first of two NHL Global Series games against Carolina at Veikkaus Arena in Helsinki. The second follows Saturday.

coming.h: Wet, breezy Friday as next storm arrives
coming.s: Widespread rain arrives Thursday night and continues into a breezy Friday. Showers last through Saturday, with another round of rain and wind on Sunday.

coming.h: Seahawks at Raiders in Las Vegas
coming.s: Week 10 kickoff is at 1:05 p.m. PT at Allegiant Stadium, on CBS.
